messages:
PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: PAGED Kyra for INC-2026 — unusual auth attempts hitting honeypot endpoints from 203.0.113.45/32 and 198.51.100.0/24, ~12k requests in 3m. Root TS: 7990011223
Kyra: oncall here, grabbing logs now. any customer-facing errors?
Mike: i see a spike in 401s for auth-proxy v2 in us-east-1, not impacting token service latency. looks like automated scraping.
Kyra: good, prioritize containment. Anika, can you confirm if keys appear in logs (PII/leak)?
Anika: looking — there are repeated attempts against honeytoken keys (svc-honey-*) and a few requests that include a header with what looks like an internal debug token. no customer tokens in honeypot logs so far.
Kyra: ok. immediate actions: block offending IPs at edge, enable stricter WAF rule, rotate any exposed service tokens, and kick off key rotation for svc-auth-proxy if evidence of theft.
DevOps Bot: Deploying temporary WAF rule id=waf-temp-799 to block 203.0.113.45 and rate-limit 198.51.100.0/24. ETA ~30s.
Mike: applied ip block at edge (cdn firewall) for 203.0.113.45. seeing drop in requests from that IP.
Kyra: Anika, can you run quick grep across prod logs for patterns that match the honeytoken? Example: "Authorization: Bearer svc-honey-"
Anika: running now, sharing results in 2m. so far only hits in honeytennant-vip stream.
Kyra: Sam (CS), set status page to monitoring? no customer errors yet but let's prep messaging if tokens rotated.
Sam: will draft a short internal note and standby customer comms. no public update yet.
Anika: grep result: 4 matches in staging-forwarder and 0 in prod-api-auth logs. timestamps align with spike window. looks like log-forwarder routing rule sent honeypot logs to splunk index xfer-legacy — investigating potential misconfig.
Kyra: aha — misrouted log-forwarder could explain leak vector. DevOps, can you pause the forwarder and quarantine the index?
DevOps Bot: pausing log-forwarder: `./ctl forwarder pause --name log-forwarder-2 --reason quarantine` — paused. Exporting last 1h to secure-s3 for forensic.
Mike: quick containment checklist I'm running:
```
# block ips
edge-cli block-ip 203.0.113.45
edge-cli block-range 198.51.100.0/24
# pause forwarder
./ctl forwarder pause --name log-forwarder-2
# revoke service key (example)
aws iam update-access-key --user-name svc-forwarder --access-key-id AKIAEXAMPLE --status Inactive
```
Kyra: Anika, any evidence of customer credential strings in the misrouted index?
Anika: scanning exports — no clear customer tokens. found debug snippets and a few internal service keys (honey and one rotated test key). recommending rotating the svc-forwarder key anyway.
Kyra: agreed. Mike, execute rotation for svc-forwarder and svc-auth-proxy (schedule immediate). Post rotation commands and confirm rollouts.
Mike: rotating now. will use zero-downtime approach: create new key, add to forwarder config, verify, then revoke old. ETA 8m.
DevOps Bot: new keys provisioned and injected via secrets manager for svc-forwarder. verifying health checks.
Mike: health checks green. revoking old key now.
Kyra: good. Legal, any early guidance on notification threshold if internal keys were exposed but customer data not?
Legal: if internal service keys only and no customer tokens, we treat as internal incident and document. escalate to privacy only if we confirm customer credentials or PII exfil. please preserve all artifacts and follow evidence handling.
Sam: CS: preparing customer impact matrix and standby template. will notify affected customers within 24h if we find customer impact.
Anika: forensic notes: misroute caused by stale rule in log-router v1.3.7 — rule matched honeypot stream and forwarded to legacy splunk index. will patch router to require explicit allowlists.
Kyra: action items consolidated: 1) block IPs & WAF rule (done), 2) pause forwarder & export logs (done), 3) rotate svc-forwarder & svc-auth-proxy keys (done), 4) patch log-router allowlist + deploy (in progress), 5) preserve artifacts for Legal/Privacy (Anika), 6) CS messaging template (Sam).
Mike: deploying log-router patch now: `git push && deploy log-router --canary 5%`
DevOps Bot: canary deploy started for log-router patch (5%). monitoring for errors.
Kyra: on-call handoff in 30m — @Mike you'll be lead for follow-up, @Anika you remain investigation lead, @Sam coordinate customer comms, @Legal hold for updates. I'll leave post-incident doc in #incidents when I hand off.
Mike: noted, I'll pick this up. good job team :thumbsup:
Anika: collecting all hashes and preserved S3 objects; will share for postmortem.
Legal: confirm retention of full log export in secure bucket for 90 days, access limited to IR team.
Kyra: leaving the channel for now, handing to Mike. PagerDuty Bot: incident acknowledged by Mike. Last TS: 7990011400
